notes.title: 🛸 Alien Market Simulator - Major Update v0.1!
notes.notes:
[h3]👮‍♂️ [b]Guard Staff[/b]
The Guard is now available to help maintain order within your station. They will remove biomass growths and ensure your goods remain safe by driving away robbers such as the [i]Mucklet[/i].[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/31a1d5b6f001234ae5eb5ec0cee7319a9a82e8bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🍳 [b]Chef Staff[/b] The Chef brings food service to your market. They prepare dishes using your stocked products and serve them directly to customers, improving both customer satisfaction and efficiency.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/86ac4c6fb6abe8d0ea2739572b9910deea579236.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🧴 [b]New Product: Gloop by Zeep[/b]
A new bottled item, [b]Gloop by Zeep[/b], has been added to the product catalog. Customers have shown particular interest in this item, so be sure to keep it in stock.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/4dce3f02457f7aea606a71561d7b7547ea42d581.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]⚒️Bugs Fixes:[/h2][h3]Fixed bugs related to restoker, food stall, food customers and more.[/h3]

notes.notes: [h2]🆕 What’s New[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]2 New Decorations[/b] to customize your station.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/6e62185fe78e68770f2704b584bbd7e635110455.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Save Slots[/b] for easier progress management.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/a2ffaa351588caa03a0c36ea0282dcbea951a9e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Restocker Issue:[/b] Fixed a problem where two restockers could place different items on the same shelf.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chairs Issue:[/b] Resolved an issue where chairs were not connected to tables after loading a saved game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Continue Button Issue:[/b] Fixed a bug where the continue button appeared grayed out on a second device.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🚀 What’s Coming (Big Update Soon!)[/h3][list][*][p][b]Chef Staff[/b] – They’ll cook and serve aliens delicious meals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guard Staff[/b] – Keeping your station secure from bugs and protecting you against theft.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it helps us make Alien Market Simulator better with every update![/p]

notes.title: 🛸 Alien Market Simulator - v0.06 Update!
notes.notes: [h3]🪟 Shelve Properties[/h3][p]Shelves now display key properties—such as tagged items, current item count, and adjustable pricing—making it easier to manage your inventory at a glance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/ec0178593b24d9c4fd2029abe9ddd20da0d087e7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🤖 Restocker Improvements[/h3][p]Restocker staff have been upgraded! They now place items on the correct shelves, keeping your shop neat and well-organized automatically.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📦 Item Quantities in Shop & Storage[/h3][p]In the [b]Shop Manage[/b] tab, each item now shows how many units are available both on shelves and in storage, helping you restock efficiently.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/b9d1c8da0fa61a41b0c316b0d43709335f1112ed.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]⛽ Fuel Capacity Indicator[/h3][p]The [b]Manage Fuel[/b] tab now displays both the [b]current[/b] and [b]maximum[/b] fuel levels, so you can better plan refueling for your station.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/1b4d44b6bdae389037a4e87b55e241a1ebf5cb52.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🛸 Alien Market Simulator - v0.05 Update! 🛍️
notes.notes: [h2]👽 [b]🧠 Restocker Staff Arrives![/b][/h2][p] Meet your new best friend: the [b]Restocker[/b]! This helpful employee automatically picks up boxes and refills your shelves with products. No more running around micro-managing stock — just hire one and let them do the heavy lifting (literally).\[/p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/d4adc5b37ccd190b78d09805b6e963ffafb3471d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] 📊 [b]🗓️ Daily Report Tab[/b]Ever wondered how much profit you made, what sold best, or how much you spent on staff? Now you can! The new [b]Daily Report Tab[/b] gives you a clean summary of each day’s performance — perfect for planning your next move (or realizing you’ve been scammed by that shady alien).[/p][p] ⏱️ [b]🌅 Days Are Shorter Now[/b]We’ve shortened the in-game day length slightly to keep the pace snappy and gameplay tighter. Less waiting, more selling![/p][p] 🧾 [b]📋 Market Management UI Upgrade[/b]The [b]Market Management[/b] screen has all your reports, and Parking Update as well. More is coming.[/p][p] 🏆 [b]🎉 Customer Achievement Fix[/b]We’ve fixed a bug where certain [b]customer-related achievements[/b] weren’t unlocking properly. Your hard-earned milestones will now be tracked and rewarded correctly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]And Many Errors Fixed...[/b][/p]

notes.title: Minor Fixes and changes!
notes.notes:
[h2]Minor Changes are here:[/h2]
We are actively looking at the players feedback and the actively working to fix major issue.

[h3]Performance and Crashes fixed:[/h3]
After day and night of nailing down the issue, we have fixed the crashes, also did many optimization for a smoother experience.

[h3]Staff AI Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now staff will go back to the task it was doing after the charge is complete.
[*] Cleaner AI is better now! 
[*] Staff will now go to nearest charging station for charge.
[/list]

[h3]Customer and Food stall:[/h3]
Customer will come after some delay for the food, so it wont get overwhelming.

notes.title: Alien Market Simulator – Early Access Release is Here! 👽🛍️
notes.notes:
[h3]The release date is set! Alien Market Simulator officially launches on May 26, 2025 🚀📆
[/h3]
Get ready to manage the weirdest space station in the galaxy! Turn a dusty pit stop into a thriving alien marketplace—scan strange items, fuel bizarre ships, cook questionable meals, and haggle with lifeforms that may or may not have a concept of currency.

🛒 Run a chaotic alien shop
🧽 Clean bathrooms (yes, really)
🍜 Cook wild alien food
🛢️ Fuel up plasma, nuclear, and anti-matter ships
🤖 Hire robots, order deliveries, and dodge space loan sharks
🌱 Survive a living world that grows (or mutates) around you

Whether you're scanning snacks or stopping a rabbit-creature from swallowing your stock, every day is a cosmic adventure.

Wishlist now and get ready to open shop on May 26! 🪐

notes.title: Staff Charging Station and Localization Update.
notes.notes:
A new demo update is here!

[h2]Staff Charging Station:[/h2]
Staff robots run on battery. Keep an eye on there charging and make sure they are charged. Buy the charging station from the AKEA store and place it in the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/dec5f8627c3f17cc11fe753d3cf337bf0ba035f3.png[/img]

[h2]Localization Redone:[/h2]
We have redone previous languages translation. Now it would be easy for players from different countries to play the game.

[h2]New languages:[/h2]
We have also added new languages to the game. [b]Russian, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese[/b]. We hope players who speak these languages will enjoy the game more now.

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce a major update for the Alien Market Sim Demo, packed with new features, optimizations, and fixes to make your extraterrestrial market management even smoother. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Demo time increased: [/h3]
We have increased the demo playtime to Level 3. And even after that you are free to play as long as you want.

[h3]Cleaner Staff: [/h3]
Keep your market spotless with the new Cleaner Staff! They’ll ensure your station is clean. But they have limited range, dont worry you can upgrade that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/80f97b52330f68ea443cdab3d5a0e43da4ceb0e2.gif[/img]

[h3]Fueling Staff:[/h3]
Power up your market’s operations with dedicated Fueling Staff. Just assign them a fueling station by taking them near one of the station and setting the task!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/ff4c022e14f6d3104c0f6b89a5bfc36a05e5f7e2.gif[/img]

[h3]Staff Upgrades: [/h3]
Each staff has some unique properties, you can upgrade them over time. Make them fast and efficient.

[h3]Staff Management Tab: [/h3]
Take full control of your workforce with the new Staff Management Tab. Manage your team with ease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/283b8e00090bcf6f71cfaa03fdad01a66dd1d94e.gif[/img]

[h3]Staff Wanders Around:[/h3]
Got a staff member with some free time? Now you can let them wander around the station, adding a little life and personality to your alien market!

[h3]Set Price Easily:[/h3]
With a single click on the price text, you can change prices of the items now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/832bb4bff6947403fbbea024c3cd7daad9c1d1f9.gif[/img]

[h3]Control Unit Area:[/h3]
A new dedicated area for managing your market’s core systems. Also the garbage disposal machine is here now, with a new and improved lever system for disposal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/69d28c14ce9adc30271ff3cd81114545005fdbed.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Save System Errors Fixed:[/h3]
No more lost progress! We’ve resolved issues with the save system to ensure your market data is safe and sound.

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
Enjoy a smoother experience with performance improvements across the board.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Squashed pesky bugs that were causing trouble. Your market will now run more reliably than ever.

We’re constantly working to make Alien Market Sim the best it can be, and your feedback is invaluable. Try out the new features and let us know what you think!

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy market managing!

[h3]- The Alien Market Sim Team
[/h3]
P.S. Don’t forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the full game if you haven’t already! 🚀
